deployment_quality_annotation.detail: The program invokes Zappa's own save-python-settings-file command to create zappa_settings.py from the checked-in test configuration, then copies the checkout's tracked zappa/ext/django_zappa.py implementation to the top-level module name imported by the pinned project. These are executable local deployment artifacts, not evaluator modifications, but their runtime completeness remains a separate quality axis.
